action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 - <<'PY'
import json,urllib.request,urllib.error
UA="Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36"
for hdrs in [
  {"Content-Type":"application/json","User-Agent":UA},
  {"Content-Type":"application/json","User-Agent":UA,"Accept":"application/json"},
]:
    req=urllib.request.Request("https://dash.allmodels.io/api/free-credits/claim",
        data=json.dumps({"claimToken":"x","recaptchaToken":"y","trigger":"auto"}).encode(),headers=hdrs)
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=30) as r: print(list(hdrs), r.status, r.read()[:200])
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e: print(list(hdrs),"->",e.code,e.read()[:200])
PY
